notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 51.
description:
Activate Aetherflux Resevoir by paying fifty life, targeting yourself and causing you to gain 150 life due to Purity and City on Fire.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Activate Aetherflux Resevoir by paying fifty life, dealing fifty damage to any target.
Repeat step 3.
